w.name: West Zone
w.bounds: West Zone: between the Texas line and the line south on LA Hwy 79 (US 79 on the ground) from the Arkansas border to Homer, LA 9 to Arcadia, LA 147 to Hodge, US 167 to Lafayette, then south and east on US 90 to the Mississippi line — so the coast south of US 90 is West.
w.note: Ducks Nov 14 – Dec 6, Dec 19 – Jan 24. Youth / veterans Nov 7 and Jan 30.

e.name: East Zone
e.bounds: East Zone: the remainder of the state.
e.note: Ducks Nov 21 – Dec 6, Dec 19 – Jan 31. Youth / veterans Nov 14 and Feb 6.

seasonsNote: Duck dates differ by zone (West / East). Teal, black-bellied whistling ducks, geese, rails and snipe are statewide. WMAs set their own days, hours and closed areas.

seasons.label: Black-bellied whistling ducks
seasons.note: Free permit and mandatory reporting (Oct 12–26); only black-bellied whistling ducks may be taken.

seasons.label: Light and white-fronted geese
seasons.note: Conservation Order for light geese Dec 7–18 and Feb 8 – Mar 7 (no limit).

bags.detail: Six ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit.
Light geese 20 (no possession limit); white-fronted geese 3 (9).
Regular limits, but 0 mottled ducks and 1 scaup before the regular season, 1 mottled duck and 2 scaup after it.

duckSublimits.note: 1 for the first 15 days of the season, then 2 (2 from Nov 29 in the West, Dec 6 in the East)
none for the first 15 days, then 1

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset (federal rule); many WMAs end at noon on opening weekends or have their own hours.
Federal rules: approved non-toxic shot for waterfowl; shotguns plugged to 3 shells (except the light goose Conservation Order).

The waterfowl sanctuaries on Biloxi, Boeuf and Russell Sage WMAs are closed to all access from Nov 1 through the end of the light goose Conservation Order; the Bodcau sanctuary Nov 1 – Mar 7. Not drawn (inside the WMA outlines).
Internal combustion engine boats are prohibited from noon to 4 a.m., Nov 1 – Jan 31, on certain WMAs (see the pamphlet).
West: Nov 7, 2026 and Jan 30, 2027. East: Nov 14, 2026 and Feb 6, 2027. The adult may not hunt ducks on youth days.
Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

licences.d: Required in addition to the Basic Season licence.

geometryNote: Geometry: the West / East line routed on OpenStreetMap’s US 79, LA 9, LA 147, US 167 and US 90 (US 90 in legs: OSM’s US 90 is not one connected path across the Mississippi at New Orleans); LDWF WMAs and refuges; LDWF boat launches; USGS NHD (water; streams from the NHD small-scale layer) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); NOAA CO-OPS (tides); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions, borders).
